note: PROSPECTIVE (Expansion 19, PROS-19, wip/expansion19-preparation): NPC judgment and decision weighting. The owner answered SJD-Q01, Q02, Q06, Q07, Q08, Q10, Q11 and Q14 on 2026-10-21 (docs/directives/2026-10-21_expansion19_sjd_final_decisions.md): their RULES are implemented here; their NUMBERS (rates, weights, thresholds) are still agent proposals unless the owner set them. The owner answered Q03, Q04, Q05, Q09, Q12 and Q13 and X19-ASSAULT, X19-GUARD, X19-HARMED, X19-CRT12, X19-DECAY on 2026-10-23 (docs/directives/2026-10-23_owner_answers_*.md); Q05 'Not at all' removed the prior bias; Q09 'near-best' is selection margin with runner_up_permille 150 (AGENT-PROPOSED number); assault is permanent (X19-ASSAULT). X19-DECAY (half-life) is decided in the directive but its rate here is untouched until the calendar is explained. docs/expansion19/DESIGN.md reconciles every setting with the decisions. Points are integer milli-points (1000 = 1 point) and fractions integer permille (1000 = 1.0), so replay and saves are exact. enabled is false: nothing in the live game reads or writes judgment unless a test turns it on.
_events_note: The event catalog (spec s.3; SJD-Q12, provisional: what is worth scoring). Every event is a fact (Q01). polarity GOOD or BAD gives the baseline the observer's interpretation is relative to; NEUTRAL facts (meetings, marriages) are recorded, remembered and told like any other and score only by an optional per-observer rule "personal" {severity, beneficiary, victim, kin, friend: P permille}; none is set, so they mean nothing morally to anyone (Q01: no automatic moral significance). severity: milli-points (spec seed values: minor help 0.5, theft 1, rescue 2, killing 3). permanent: a murder (Q02, Q11) or an assault (X19-ASSAULT, 2026-10-23: 'Permanent', like murder): memories of it never fade and judgments from it never decay. min_value: a theft or trade below this many coins of goods is not scored. (SJD-Q05 'Not at all', 2026-10-23: no event is read through prior opinion; the ambiguous flag and the prior bias are removed.)
_interpret_note: Signed interpretation P in permille (spec s.4; Q08: personal morality, relationships, loyalties and who was affected; law is separate and not modelled here). The victim of a BAD event or the beneficiary of a GOOD one reads it at affected; the actor's partner in a BAD deed at accomplice; others by their tie to the affected party (kin, friend, else bystander), reversed to rival when they judge the affected party at or below rival_net_at. Loyalty to the actor (kin_of_actor, friend_of_actor) softens condemnation. morality_spread_permille: each person's own moral sensitivity per family of deeds, fixed by the seed, 1000 +/- this (proposal; never applied to the one affected). No prior-opinion bias exists (SJD-Q05 'Not at all'). Every number here is an agent proposal.
_belief_note: Provenance and confidence (Q06). Witnesses and participants are firsthand: their confidence is witnessed or participant, no storyteller to weigh. A told story's confidence: the teller's confidence x hop_factor x credibility; credibility is the listener's trust in the immediate teller: credibility_stranger for no tie, rising to 1000 with the existing relationship number (Relations regard 0..100), moved by the listener's judgment of the teller (credibility_permille_per_point a point of NET), within credibility_min..1000. Over several people the product along the chain is the transmission history. confidence_policy (multiplier: impact = S x P x C). Numbers are agent proposals.
_trust_note: X19-REGARD (owner 2026-10-23, 'Separate them': liking and trust tracked apart). Liking stays Relations' regard (it sets how close two people are, so which gossip passes). Trust is the listener's reliance on another person, milli-points 0..100000, kept in the judgment store (trust_of) and saved with it; it sets credibility (belief.credibility_*). With no record it is a first impression, regard x seed_from_regard_permille (so a stranger starts at 0 and a well-liked newcomer a little above). What moves it: an event type's own 'trust' milli-points (a fair deal raises, a cheat or a false charge lowers) times the observer's confidence and the actor's share, once a belief is first formed; a story a teller told that is later borne out by what the listener learns first-hand (rumour_confirmed) or shown wrong, with another actor (rumour_false). Kept promises and contracts would use the same per-event 'trust' field once the game publishes them as events. No decay (proposal). ALL NUMBERS ARE AGENT PROPOSALS awaiting owner review.
_memory_note: Personal memory (Q11). Ordinary memories: at most capacity a person; salience starts at severity x confidence (a NEUTRAL fact at neutral_salience) and fades salience_fade_permille a day; under forget_below it is forgotten. Permanent memories (never fade, never pushed out, not counted in capacity, their facts never retire): murder always (the type's permanent), anything at least permanent_severity, and, for the one it happened to (victim or beneficiary), anything at least permanent_personal_severity (proposal: being assaulted or rescued yourself). Forgetting keeps the judgment (retract_on_forget false; the judgment fades by decay instead, Q02). horizon_days: how long an ordinary event can still be told or corrected (an engineering bound on facts and dedup keys; permanent records are exempt). dawn_slices: the daily update is spread over this many hours (same result however sliced).
_decay_note: Q02: ordinary GOOD and BAD judgments fade very slowly; murder never. ordinary_permille_per_day is a PROPOSED value, NOT APPROVED (the owner asked for a conservative configurable value demonstrated before approval): 3 permille a day halves an old opinion in about 231 game days (about 29 game years of 8 days). Demonstration: game/tests/judgment_decay_demo.gd and docs/expansion19/DESIGN.md. 0 turns decay off.
_gossip_note: Word of mouth (Q07): only when two people actually spend time together (Relations' shared hours); no hop limit, no confidence floor: a story travels as far as real meetings carry it. Exchange limits per conversation: per_meeting memories each way, daily_budget tellings a teller a day. A teller only shares with someone whose judgment of them is above share_net_at (proposal). Each person judges each event once; a belief is replaced only by a more confident one. misattribute_permille: the chance (seeded hash) a rumour names the wrong actor (0: off). pump_per_tick: queued meetings told each World tick (same result whatever the pace). timing: "scheduled" (the owner's answer to X19-Q-TIMING, 2026-10-23: gossip spreads organically by contact and closeness: each meeting is told at its own minute of the hour, no catch-up) or "hour" (the reference mode: meetings count as told at the hour's start; kept for the identity tests and measurements, not used live). closeness_floor_permille: the chance a story passes in a meeting between strangers (regard 0), rising to certain at regard 100 (AGENT-PROPOSED number, awaiting owner review; 1000 turns the weighting off). Credibility (belief.credibility_*) already scales how far the listener believes by the same regard.
_personality_note: SJD-Q03 (owner 2026-10-23, 'Own tolerance each': personality-based thresholds seeded at birth; some forgive quickly, some hold grudges) and SJD-Q13 ('Born with + shaped by life': weights seeded from personality at birth, then nudged by what happens to them; deterministic). The game has no personality system, so each person's temperament is a hash of the world seed and their id (nothing stored for it, identical after save/load). TOLERANCE scales the two NET thresholds (interpret.rival_net_at: when a bystander turns rival; gossip.share_net_at: whom a teller will still talk to): 1000 +/- tolerance_spread_permille; above 1000 a person puts up with more before souring, below 1000 holds a grudge sooner. WEIGHTS: decision.trait_spread_permille moves each decision weight of each person by up to that much either way (per factor). LIFE EVENTS (firsthand only: the person's own experience as victim or beneficiary, once per event): being the victim of a BAD deed lowers tolerance by tolerance_per_point x severity points; being the beneficiary of a GOOD deed raises the weight on disposition (what they think of others, hence trust in a helper) by weight_per_point x severity points; each shift is bounded to +/- max_shift_permille and saved in the judgment section ('life'). ALL NUMBERS ARE AGENT PROPOSALS awaiting owner review; 0 spread and 0 steps turn the whole thing off.
_bonds_note: X19-FOUND-BONDS and X19-FOUND-FAMREP (owner directive 2026-10-23, sections 4 and 5; judgment_bonds.gd). A pair's history (the highest regard ever reached, a former-friend flag that never stacks, betrayals never erased) and resentment (a value apart from regard, trust and NET). familiarity_permille 100 and family_permille 50 are the owner's ~10% and ~5% calibration targets and combined_permille 120 the owner's ~12% when both qualify: deterministic multipliers on a regard gain applied by Relations BEFORE its daily caps (no cap raised, no days-known gate shortened). Active negative standing (suspends familiarity): resentment above zero in either direction, or either one's NET of the other below negative_net_below. A serious grievance (severity at least serious_severity) cannot soften before serious_floor_days (0: Life.year_days(), one in-game year); softening is only through personality growth and soften_milli_per_day is 0 (inert): no decay curve is invented. reach is the unresolved X19-SPILL-REACH (none: no family reputation at all; line = parents and children, family = plus siblings and partner are fixtures for tests); transmission X19-REP-TRANSMIT is the identity; every other number is an AGENT PLACEHOLDER awaiting the owner (X19-BOND-LIMITS). friend_level 0: Relations' befriend_at.

bonds._status: familiarity/family/combined are owner targets; everything else proposed, unapproved; reach and transmit unresolved

_decision_note: Decision weighting (spec s.7; Q14: judgment is one weighted influence inside the existing decision points; SJD-Q03 own tolerance and Q13 weights: see personality and trait_spread_permille; Q04 ambivalence is stored with weight 0; Q09 answered: selection margin, the best usually, a seeded close second runner_up_permille of the time (AGENT-PROPOSED 150)). The live decision code supplies the feasible candidates and factor values (0..100000: milli-points on the spec's 0..100 scale); disposition = 50 points + NET, clamped to 0..100. utility = sum(weight permille x factor) / 1000. live_order: the live code's own preference (first 100 points, 10 less for each after), so with every judgment neutral the live choice stands. forgo: the utility of doing without. integration: which existing decision points consult judgment when a store is attached (all of them off with judgment off). Every weight is an agent proposal.
